title: finding(components,security): `page:header` builds the record page H1 from the raw served row — a policy-denied `titleFormat` token or `nameField` prints in the title (the sibling of objectui#10434)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a render probe. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from objectui#10434 (PR objectui#10491, class a). The dev probed it, and the PR's contract review confirmed it by reading. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here. It is the host objectui#10434's claim deliberately left out: `@object-ui/components` has no permission source.

## The defect

objectui#10434 gates the record title at the hosts that hold a permission source: `DetailView`'s header H1, `record:details`' dedupe, and `RecordDetailView`'s breadcrumb / favourite / recent title. Each now computes from the row with policy-denied fields removed (objectui#10411's `!perms.isLoaded || perms.checkField(object, f, 'read')`). The record page's default composition puts `page:header` over `record:details`. `PageHeaderRenderer` (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`) builds `declaredTitle`, the interpolated `titleFormat` and `unifiedTitle` from the raw `ctx.data`, with no permission read.

Probe (the objectui#10434 dev, scratch, real `PermissionProvider` denying `email`, on a backend that does not strip):

| title source | `page:header` H1 |
|:--|:--|
| `titleFormat: '{email}'` | `ada@example.com` |
| `nameField: 'email'` | `ada@example.com` |
| `titleFormat: '{name} - {email}'` | `Ada Lovelace - ada@example.com` |

## The interim cost this card also owns

The seat ruled (A, recorded on objectui#10434's ACCEPT) to keep `record:details`' dedupe on the gated row, because that is the end state. Until `page:header` is gated, under `page:header` + a non-stripping backend + a policy denying the title's field, the dedupe hides the fallen-through `name` row beneath an H1 that prints the denied value. For a single-field title, the readable name is then on screen nowhere. ⇒ This card's pin should cover the `name` row returning once `page:header` reads the gated row.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- **Routing:** `@object-ui/components`' `@object-ui/*` dependencies are core, i18n, react, react-runtime, sdui-parser and types, with no permissions package. So the gate needs a routing decision: a dependency, an injected read policy through context, or gating the row before it reaches `ctx.data`.
- **Defence in depth**, as objectui#10434: ObjectStack's `FieldMasker` deletes denied keys server-side.
- **Related observation from PR objectui#10491's review:** with an async policy provider, `RecordDetailView`'s title can reach the breadcrumb, Recently Accessed and a favourite label for the window before `isLoaded` flips; it self-corrects when it does. That is objectui#10411's A2 rule applied as ruled. Worth a line in this card's pins if the persisted stores should be covered.
- **Siblings,** to be filed at the seat's next fire: search result labels (`useRecordSearch`'s `getDisplayName`), and the lookup cell (`resolveLookupRecordName`).

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items. The pattern `page:header` / `PageHeaderRenderer` near title / FLS / `checkField` / permission ⇒ none beyond objectui#10434 itself.

Dedupe words: `page:header title FLS` · `PageHeaderRenderer denied field` · `record page H1 checkField` · `titleFormat page header permission`
